title: Non-Binary Gender Expression in Online Interactions

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing online attention, activity levels, and the toxicity scores of tweets sent and received across different Twitter user groups categorized by their self-declared pronouns (binary vs. non-binary) using the Detoxify model.

Analyzing the overlap between profanity usage and high toxicity scores in tweets from non-binary users to evaluate whether toxicity classifiers disproportionately flag the dialect used in queer communities as toxic.
